descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Formare tehnică și vocațională, Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
The HR Digital activity is part of the BU HCM in France.
 HR Digital is a social reporting and HR decisional offering based on SAP BI & Oracle DBMS technologies.
 The clients are very large companies either on French or international scope, using our solution to collect the date from one-to-many data sources, harmonize and consolidate in a single repository, provide the expert users feature to create their own reports and end-users pre-defined reports on HR domains.
 Part of the HCM Centre of Excellence, the Client service solution engineer will be part of a back office in charge of the development, the maintenance and the production of the final solution of our more than 60 clients, will be in contact with the front office (account managers) to provide clients a service of excellence.
 Your main responsibilities will be to deliver activities that combine analytical and design skills with appropriate knowledge of software and hardware technology, in order to define, design, implementation, test and modify the Reporting solution.
 KEY DUTIES/TASKS: 
Creating reports based on the existing solution or new components of the existing solution in the following environments
SAP BI Universe (setting up, maintaining)
Oracle dbms (developing and maintaining - tables, views, stored procedures, index)
ETL (developing and maintaining - dataflows, unit modules, procedures)
SAP BI (report writing)
HR Training, HR Process, HR Intelligence applications
Activities to carry out the analysis to define the specifications for the effective construction of information systems, likely to meet the requirements of the users.
Translating the functional needs into a technical analysis
Estimating the workload to realize, test, document and deliver the technical solution
Defining, planning and executing the unit and integration tests
Documenting the solution and the delivery form
Analyzing the discrepancies on solution
Doing the follow up or monitor data or reports production
Alerting the manager or account manager when needed (delay, consistency)
Maintenance of existing reports for our customers
Customizations for existing reports
Quotation (time) of assigned requests treatment
Development with high outstanding quality work
Write and maintain the technical documents on requests/developments
Follows the defined process (and propose improvement when appropriate)
Exchange with front office
Reporting to manager
 EDUCATION: 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Math, Engineering, or equivalent discipline required
 SKILLS 
Required Technical skills
3+years knowledge and experience with Oracle PL-SQL
Proficiency in English
Knowledge and experience with Business Objects platform including Web Intelligence, Infoview /BI Launchpad, CMC are a +
Knowledge and experience with an ETL tool are a +
Knowledge of java or other programming languages is a +
A good French level (minimum B1) 
Desired Technical skills
Ability to perform data analysis in HR environments
 SOFT SKILLS 
Good interpersonal skills
Good oral and written communication skills
Organized
Rigorous
Independent
Have team spirit
Possesses a continuous improvement mind-set and is receptive to change
